name: ESL task fan-in + transform-stage pipeline
author: cp-4895 (WP-6, ADR-0005 D3 §1b row) -- flow/DAG sub-family, reuses the cp-4892 \foreach generator convention for the stage chain
description: Two task-nodes fan into a parametric \nstages-long proc-stage pipeline (direction-axis, monotone L->R), a dashed group-box wraps a contiguous run of fused stages (containment: grouped stages), and the last stage emits a param-node output artifact placed off the main axis (relative-placement). Realizes the contract §1b flow/DAG components: task-node, proc-stage, param-node, flow-edge, group-box. Colors reuse the ESL domain-semantic scheme (core-accent=task-node, process-accent=proc-stage per its contract role "flow transform-stage accent", param-accent=param-node, digitaldomain=flow-edge/group-box neutral structure).

parameters.name: \nstages
parameters.meaning: number of pipeline stages in the chain

parameters.name: \gbstart
parameters.meaning: first stage index the fused-stage group-box wraps (0 = omit the group-box)

parameters.name: \gbend
parameters.meaning: last stage index the fused-stage group-box wraps

parameters.name: \stagegap
parameters.meaning: horizontal gap between successive stage boxes

edit_contract.node_naming: task-node: (task-a); task-node: (task-b); proc-stage: stage-<i> (generated, index-addressable); param-node: (param-out); group-box: (fusedgroup)

operations.summary: edit \nstages -- the generator re-derives every stage node name and position; no coordinate ever needs hand-editing
edit \gbstart/\gbend to move or resize the fused-stage group-box, or set \gbstart to 0 to omit it entirely
edit \taskalabel/\taskblabel/\paramoutlabel/\groupcaption for text; stage labels are the generator's own S<i> index, not a separate macro per stage
\stagewidth/\stagegap control stage box size and chain density

change the domain-semantic color for a whole role (tasknode/procstage/paramnode/flowedge/groupbox) in that role's style definition; keep the family assignments (core-accent=task-node, process-accent=proc-stage, param-accent=param-node, digitaldomain=flow-edge/group-box) unless a family settled-decisions record overrides it

invariants: a template must not name a semantic component the contract's §1 vocabulary does not define (§1 extensibility rule)
style/color bindings carry their contract §2 token role; a role's color is never swapped for decoration
(seam: no WP-7 family settled-decisions record yet for family 'flow'; family-specific placement/style/semantic invariants project here once it lands)
